acceptanceCriteria: Explicit claim and claim-next with --pool POOL and one or more --exclude-member MEMBER values never allocate or execute health for an excluded member, including matching-stage reservations, fallback members and prepared-allocation admission.
Plan preview accepts the same exclusions and uses identical stage/order/occupancy eligibility; all excluded or unavailable members give RESOURCE_COLLISION, with no new allocation or member command.

CLI exclusions normalize a bounded sorted unique member-label set; syntax, canonical set and absolute bounds precede replay, but current-pool membership/count validation applies only to fresh admission after authoritative replay, before every health preparation and final prepared allocation. Unknown or cross-pool members and exclusions without a pool refuse fresh transitions.

Absent exclusions preserve fixed historical request bytes/order; identical replay returns original receipt-bound allocation after successor allocation or permitted policy change removes an excluded free member, while changed valid sets under the same request ID conflict before current-policy checks. Both dedicated repeatable CLI parsers normalize reordered duplicate exclusion values.

Preserve complete declared resources, requiresPool enforcement, allocation tuple binding, quarantine and safe confirmation; document this as enforced caller-selected member exclusion, not authenticated independent reviewer identity or automatic ticket-history discovery.

Retain focused transaction/store/CLI tests, disposable true-native fixture qualification, independent review, CAL/CEM/frozen checks, CI/integration and native submit/gate/complete/readback/receipt audit.

Source: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/480
Public source baseline 1fda1b94984245d0cd0ac0a6d17cc72572ce6619, 2026-10-02. Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163 / Tasks build.202; official tags v1.0.0-rc.1/tasks-dev-20260929.2 observed, qualification limits retained.
Issue reports review claims can land on the author's or an already verified member because reservedFor is preferred ordering with unreserved fallback. Request explicitly allows a smaller per-claim --exclude-member alternative. Proposed smallest property: caller supplies exact members to exclude; allocation and health preparation enforce it at admission, pure preview uses the same filtering, canonical request binds exclusion set/replay. No automatic history inference or actor authentication claim.
Current source has no exclusion field in LeaseRequest/PlanInput/CLI; OrderedPoolMembers is used by allocate, poolSlots and healthClaimWith. Existing stage reservation ordering is accepted CAL-V0-029/034 and remains unchanged among eligible nonexcluded members. Native canonical policy currently has no pools; reported demo-lanes reproduction must use a disposable matching fixture after root Gate A/admission. Preserve CAL-V0-030/032/046 quarantine.
Shared ownership with issue479/V1-0674, but independent completion: exclusions mitigate pointless allocation without proving safe terminal reuse. No 479 closure from this work. Root prohibits claims/source implementation until fresh safety review and builder slot. Precise effects pending review; private plan /private/tmp/corvint-pools-479-480-gatea.md.
Initialization scope authorized by root at native2040 after145 returned2039; exact private frozen packet SHA256 bae01243243e9f2ee8027fd4838c9228584db381ce93d9635c3c4be93692f51b. Root GateA PASS /private/tmp/corvint-pool480-gate-a-review.md with replay-before-current-policy and both repeatable parsers incorporated. CAL-V0-065/S15 reserved; intent seed proposed/experimental, no delivered/qualified claim. Public/native original base1fda1b94984245d0cd0ac0a6d17cc72572ce6619; accepted human-owned per-claim exclusion intent must precede first implementation freeze. Full future effects/resources retained INCOMPLETE, no source/resource shrinking. This brief INIT excludes code, evidence publication and terminal gates; normal release/audit/handback then root grants separate phase. Current live136/146 inspected and have no conflicting GEN/schema/path resource.479 remains separately OPEN; no quarantine relaxation from480.
title: Tasks pools: enforce per-claim member exclusions before independent review allocation
